# Gab

5 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 5 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

Gab, the alt-social network: an account's public profile, its timeline (original posts, replies and reposts, newest first), one post, the comment thread under a post, and keyword post search. Rows use the unified Post / Author / Comment schemas, so they line up with X, Threads and Truth Social; a reply carries `post.ext.in_reply_to_id`, a repost the original on `post.ext.retweeted_post`. Every endpoint is 1 credit, and a deleted or missing post is a 404 that is not billed.

<!-- BEGIN:GENERATED:ENDPOINTS (auto-generated by generate-docs.ts - AIP-16b) -->

## GET /v1/gab/post - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one Gab post in the unified Post shape under `data.post`: text, media, author, like, reply and repost counts, and `published_at`. A reply carries `post.ext.in_reply_to_id`, a repost carries the original on `post.ext.retweeted_post`, and a quote post carries the quoted post on `post.ext.quoted_post`. A post that does not exist, or was deleted, returns a 404 and is not billed.

**Use when** you have a Gab post URL or id and want that single post rather than the account's whole timeline.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Gab post URL (`https://gab.com/<handle>/posts/<id>`). A bare numeric post id is accepted too. · e.g. `https://gab.com/a/posts/117445750063805239`

**Response** `Post` object at `data`, `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/Post.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+18 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {engagement_rate, estimated_reach, language, save_rate}; `post.author` {avatar_url, display_name, verified}; `post.content` {duration_seconds, media_urls, thumbnail_url}; `post.engagement` {comments, likes, shares}; `post.ext` {quoted_post, in_reply_to_id, in_reply_to_username, retweeted_post}; `post.flags` {deleted}. Never filled: `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.views`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/gab/post" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://gab.com/a/posts/117445750063805239" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/gab/post/comments - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the comments on a Gab post, up to 25 a page, in the unified Comment shape under `data.items[]`. Top-level comments and their nested replies come back in one list, in the order Gab's thread view pages them. Every row carries `comment.parent_id`: the post id for a top-level comment, or the parent comment's id for a nested reply, so the tree can be rebuilt. `engagement.likes` is the like count and `engagement.replies` is the reply count. `total` is Gab's own count of replies on the post. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` while it is present. A post that does not exist returns a 404 and is not billed.

**Use when** you want to read the discussion under a Gab post, sorted newest, oldest or top, paging on with next_cursor.
**Cost** cache 300 s
**Paging** cursor · page size not measured · depth unknown

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Gab post URL (`https://gab.com/<handle>/posts/<id>`). A bare numeric post id is accepted too. · e.g. `https://gab.com/a/posts/117445750063805239`
- `cursor` (optional, string) - The `next_cursor` value from the previous page (a page number), passed back unchanged.
- `sort` (optional, enum: newest | oldest | top) - `newest` (the default), `oldest`, or `top` (Gab's own ranking, which favours the most liked comments).
- `since` (optional, string) - Only rows published on or after this date: YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or an ISO 8601 timestamp. Rows older than it are left off each page. This list is not in date order, so the walk does not stop at the date: keep following `next_cursor`, and each page costs what a page costs even when every row on it is filtered out. A row with no date is kept. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#incremental-sync-since-stop_at_id).
- `until` (optional, string) - Only rows published on or before this date: YYYY-MM-DD (that whole UTC day is included) or an ISO 8601 timestamp. Newer rows are left off each page and the walk does not stop, so older pages follow. A row with no date is kept. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#incremental-sync-since-stop_at_id).

**Response** `CommentList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ comment, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/CommentList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `comment.text` | Comment body. |
| `comment.id` | Platform-specific comment ID (always a string) |
| `comment.published_at` | Comment creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `comment.url` | Direct URL to the comment on the source platform |
| `comment.author.username` | Comment author username (null when tombstoned) |
| `comment.parent_id` | Parent comment ID for nested replies, or null for… |

+8 more (types in the full schema): `comment` {post_id}; `comment.author` {avatar_url, display_name, verified}; `comment.engagement` {likes, replies}; `comment.flags` {deleted}; `computed` {language}. Page-level: `data.comment_recency`, `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/gab/post/comments" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://gab.com/a/posts/117445750063805239" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/gab/profile - 1 credit (standard)

Returns a Gab account's public profile in the unified Author shape under `data.author`: `id` (Gab's numeric account id, as a string), `username`, `display_name`, `bio`, `avatar_url`, `url`, `verified`, `private` (the account is locked), `followers`, `following`, `posts_count` and `joined_at`. Gab does not publish a total like count, so `likes_count` is null. A handle that does not exist returns a 404 and is not billed.

**Use when** you have a Gab handle and want the account snapshot before pulling its posts.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `handle` (required) - Gab username without the @ (letters, digits and underscores, up to 30 characters), as in gab.com/<handle>. · e.g. `a`

**Response** `Author` object at `data`, `{ author, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/Author.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `author.id` | Platform-specific user ID… |
| `author.url` | Direct URL to the profile page |
| `author.username` | User handle or username |
| `author.avatar_url` | URL to profile picture |
| `author.bio` | Profile biography or description |
| `author.display_name` | Display name or full name |

+11 more (types in the full schema): `author` {followers, following, posts_count, verified, joined_at, private}; `computed` {content_category, engagement_rate, estimated_reach, language, save_rate}. Never filled: `author.likes_count`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/gab/profile" \
  --data-urlencode "handle=a" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/gab/search/posts - 1 credit (standard)

Searches public Gab posts by keyword, newest first, up to 25 a page, in the unified Post shape under `data.items[]`, with the same row rules as `gab/user/posts` (replies, reposts on `post.ext.retweeted_post`, quotes on `post.ext.quoted_post`). Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page; it is absent once a short page comes back. Search operators such as `from:` are not supported: to read one account, use `gab/user/posts`. A query that matches nothing returns an empty list and is not billed.

**Use when** you want to find what Gab is saying about a topic; to read one account, use gab/user/posts instead.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** cursor · page size not measured · depth unknown

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search terms matched against post text. · e.g. `RNLI`
- `cursor` (optional, string) - The `next_cursor` value from the previous page (a page number), passed back unchanged.
- `since` (optional, string) - Only rows published on or after this date: YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or an ISO 8601 timestamp. Rows older than it are left off each page. This list is not in date order, so the walk does not stop at the date: keep following `next_cursor`, and each page costs what a page costs even when every row on it is filtered out. A row with no date is kept. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#incremental-sync-since-stop_at_id).
- `until` (optional, string) - Only rows published on or before this date: YYYY-MM-DD (that whole UTC day is included) or an ISO 8601 timestamp. Newer rows are left off each page and the walk does not stop, so older pages follow. A row with no date is kept. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#incremental-sync-since-stop_at_id).

**Response** `PostList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/PostList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+18 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {engagement_rate, estimated_reach, language, save_rate}; `post.author` {avatar_url, display_name, verified}; `post.content` {duration_seconds, media_urls, thumbnail_url}; `post.engagement` {comments, likes, shares}; `post.ext` {quoted_post, in_reply_to_id, in_reply_to_username, retweeted_post}; `post.flags` {deleted}. Never filled: `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.views`. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/gab/search/posts" \
  --data-urlencode "query=RNLI" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/gab/user/posts - 1 credit (standard)

Returns a Gab account's timeline, newest first, up to 20 posts a page, in the unified Post shape under `data.items[]`. It includes every row Gab shows on the profile: original posts, replies and reposts. A reply carries `post.ext.in_reply_to_id` and `post.ext.in_reply_to_username`. A repost keeps its own `id`, `url` and `published_at` (when it was reposted) and carries the original post on `post.ext.retweeted_post` (`id`, `url`, `author`, `text`, `media_urls`, `engagement`, `published_at`); a quote post carries the quoted post on `post.ext.quoted_post` in the same shape. `engagement.likes`, `comments` and `shares` are Gab's like, reply and repost counts. Gab sometimes drops a few rows from a page, so a page can hold fewer than 20 while more remain: keep passing `next_cursor` back as `cursor` until it is absent. A handle that does not exist returns a 404 and is not billed.

**Use when** you want it for an account's full history by handle, passing next_cursor back as cursor to walk to older posts.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** cursor · page size not measured · depth unknown

**Query params**

- `handle` (required) - Gab username without the @ (letters, digits and underscores, up to 30 characters), as in gab.com/<handle>. · e.g. `a`
- `cursor` (optional, string) - The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, passed back unchanged to fetch the next older page.
- `since` (optional, string) - Only rows published on or after this date: YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or an ISO 8601 timestamp. Rows older than it are left off each page. This list is not in date order, so the walk does not stop at the date: keep following `next_cursor`, and each page costs what a page costs even when every row on it is filtered out. A row with no date is kept. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#incremental-sync-since-stop_at_id).
- `until` (optional, string) - Only rows published on or before this date: YYYY-MM-DD (that whole UTC day is included) or an ISO 8601 timestamp. Newer rows are left off each page and the walk does not stop, so older pages follow. A row with no date is kept. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#incremental-sync-since-stop_at_id).

**Response** `PostList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/PostList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+18 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {engagement_rate, estimated_reach, language, save_rate}; `post.author` {avatar_url, display_name, verified}; `post.content` {duration_seconds, media_urls, thumbnail_url}; `post.engagement` {comments, likes, shares}; `post.ext` {quoted_post, in_reply_to_id, in_reply_to_username, retweeted_post}; `post.flags` {deleted}. Never filled: `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.views`. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/gab/user/posts" \
  --data-urlencode "handle=a" \

```
